subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should this remain the separate canonical investigation for persistent post-restart Telegram forum-topic black holes, and what recovery boundary is acceptable when a timed-out lane handler ignores abort?
rationale: The source proves an overlapping guarded-lane failure, but the field reports add durable per-topic suppression after full restarts and session deletion, which requires maintainer intent on lane release versus stronger cancellation/state cleanup before an automated repair is safe.

options.title: Keep Separate Durable-State Investigation
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical persistent topic investigation and require live or restart-replay proof before closure.

options.title: Fold After Same-Root Proof
options.body: Fold this into the guarded-lane issue only if maintainers confirm the same root cause explains the post-restart forum-topic behavior.

options.title: Sponsor A Recovery Contract
options.body: Choose the permanent recovery contract for ignored-abort handlers, then land a focused fix with tests for the default recovery and restart paths.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Durable-State Investigation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical persistent topic investigation and require live or restart-replay proof before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: Their Telegram isolated-ingress and reply-fence history is the strongest owner trail for the recovery contract at issue.
